goal: Deploy the already merged Grabowski general-alert outbox revision during a proven dispatcher quiet window, read back exact runtime identity and health, then send one secret-safe synthetic general alert through the deployed ntfy transport and verify its append-only HTTP-success acknowledgement without claiming owner-device reception or user_seen truth.
